ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; the surface is dominated by low-intensity dark-gray to black pixels with sparse, localized high-intensity white clusters primarily at the distal tips and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous white geometric blobs at the extreme distal tips (left and right terminals); scattered linear white streaks on the central-left lobe; primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark-gray region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a narrow acute angle (approx 35 degrees) and high pixel-depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile with multiple variable-depth indentations along the trailing edge; a prominent deep, wide notch is located on the inner margin of the right lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the proximal edges transitioning to a tapered concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular white pixel clusters situated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal white linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-mid section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch (tissue loss) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; numerous smaller jagged indentations across the entire trailing edge boundary.
